description:
Find assets and their networks. Each id ('ticker:network') works as from_asset or to_asset. contract: the
token's address; extra_id_name: the asset uses a memo/tag.

limit.description: How many matches to list (count has the total).

search.description: Part of a ticker or name ('usd', 'doge').

ticker.description: Exact ticker ('usdt'): lists every network it's on.

name: list_currencies
title: Find supported assets
